# Campaign extension workspace

`campaign.py` is the scored version-3 offline campaign interface.  It expands
canary and low-IID targets (`gen_targets.py`), decodes bounded plain/Zstandard
CSV captures (`classify_responses.py`), validates and reconciles revisioned
records (`ledger.py`), builds causal lease/service snapshots (`census.py`), and
solves the maximum-cardinality minimum-cost quota-constrained follow-up plan
with semantically checkable TCP/ADB/sync probe certificates (`planning.py`,
`protocols.py`).

The legacy generator CLI remains available.  The implementation is entirely
offline: it reads one JSON object from stdin, writes one JSON object to stdout,
and never opens a network socket or contacts an address.
